prompt: There is a bug report in ISSUE.md. Fix the code in this folder so the issue is resolved. Do not ask questions; make the fix.
final_response:
Fixed `merge_intervals()` in `intervals.py`:

- Sorts intervals by start (then end) before merging, so unsorted input works.
- Uses `<=` so touching intervals like `[1,3]` and `[3,5]` merge into `[1,5]`.
- Only extends the end when the new interval reaches further, handling nested intervals like `[1,10]` + `[2,3]`.
- Builds new lists without mutating the input.

All test cases pass, including mutation and edge-case checks.
